note: 原始线索来自双机实测采集；包含手工泛化模板和兼容写法，尚未逐条实机验收。wiki_context 仅列玩法语境参考页，不表示每条原文或颜色均出自这些页面。 使用完整逻辑句匹配，按原始语义保留颜色边界；不将跨时间 observed 值拼成段落。

lines.text: Select a route to master during your battle against Kuudra!
lines.zh: 选择一条天赋路线，在与 Kuudra 的战斗中发挥专长!
lines.raw: §7Select a route to master during your battle against Kuudra!

lines.text: Harness and master the power of the cannon, specialised for clearing out flying enemies and kraken tentacles!
lines.zh: 掌握火炮的威力，专门清除飞行敌人和海妖触手!
lines.raw: §7Harness and master the power of the cannon, specialised for clearing out flying enemies and kraken tentacles!

lines.text: You cannot change routes after you have selected one!
lines.zh: 选定路线后无法更改!
lines.raw: §7You cannot change routes after you have selected one!

lines.text: You cannot change routes once you have selected it. Please ensure that you and your team are happy with this decision!
lines.zh: 选定路线后无法更改。请先与你的队友确认好这个选择!
lines.raw: §7You cannot change routes once you have selected it. Please ensure that you and your team are happy with this decision!

lines.text: Perfect your ability to control and clear out the masses of enemies attacking you!
lines.zh: 专精控制与清场，消灭蜂拥而来的敌人!
lines.raw: §7Perfect your ability to control and clear out the masses of enemies attacking you!

lines.text: Specialise and focus on mastering the tasks needed to take down the beast itself!
lines.zh: 专精各项关键任务，为击败这头巨兽铺平道路!
lines.raw: §7Specialise and focus on mastering the tasks needed to take down the beast itself!

lines.text: The anchor of the group, keep you and your teammates alive as you strive to complete your goal!
lines.zh: 成为队伍的坚实后盾，保护自己和队友，齐心完成目标!
lines.raw: §7The anchor of the group, keep you and your teammates alive as you strive to complete your goal!

lines.text: Climb into a cannon and get shot out!
lines.zh: 钻进火炮，把自己发射出去!
lines.raw: §7Climb into a cannon and get shot out!

lines.text: Great for getting around or flying into Kuudra's mouth!
lines.zh: 无论是快速移动，还是飞进 Kuudra 的嘴里，都很管用!
lines.raw: §7Great for getting around or flying into Kuudra's mouth!

lines.text: Half price for Specialist route players!
lines.zh: 专家路线的玩家享受半价!
lines.raw: §7Half price for Specialist route players!

lines.text: A handy item that allows you to open the Kuudra Perk Shop anywhere in the arena!
lines.zh: 实用的便携道具，让你在竞技场内随时打开 Kuudra 天赋商店!
lines.raw: §7A handy item that allows you to open the Kuudra Perk Shop anywhere in the arena!

lines.text: This item can be kept and taken out of the instance!
lines.zh: 此物品可以保留并带出副本!
lines.raw: §7This item can be kept and taken out of the instance!

lines.text: When you don't have a lava fishing rod handy, Elle has you covered!
lines.zh: 没带熔岩钓竿? Elle 替你准备好了!
lines.raw: §7When you don't have a lava fishing rod handy, Elle has you covered!

lines.text: When you don't have a pickaxe handy, Elle has you covered!
lines.zh: 没带镐子? Elle 替你准备好了!
lines.raw: §7When you don't have a pickaxe handy, Elle has you covered!

lines.text: Consumable perks can be purchased multiple times!
lines.zh: 消耗型天赋可多次购买!
lines.raw: §7Consumable perks can be purchased multiple times!

lines.text: Increase your damage dealt against all of Kuudra's minions.
lines.zh: 提高你对 Kuudra 所有仆从造成的伤害。
lines.raw: §7Increase your damage dealt against all of Kuudra's minions.

lines.text: Decrease damage and knockback taken from Magma Bacteria while in Kuudra's Stomach.
lines.zh: 在 Kuudra 的胃部时，降低岩浆细菌对你造成的伤害与击退。
lines.raw: §7Decrease damage and knockback taken from Magma Bacteria while in Kuudra's Stomach.

lines.text: Magma Bacteria will have increased aggro on players with this perk!
lines.zh: 岩浆细菌会更容易仇视拥有此天赋的玩家!
lines.raw: §7Magma Bacteria will have increased aggro on players with this perk!

lines.text: Gain the ability to deal reduced damage to Blights during their immunity (red) phase!
lines.zh: 可在 Blight 的无敌（红色）阶段对其造成伤害，但伤害降低。
lines.raw: §7Gain the ability to deal reduced damage to Blights during their immunity (red) phase!

lines.text: Strike all nearby enemies in a %s block radius for a percentage of the damage dealt to your target!
lines.zh: 对周围 %s 格范围内的所有敌人造成伤害，伤害量为你对目标造成伤害的一定比例!
lines.raw: §7Strike all nearby enemies in a §e%s block§7 radius for a percentage of the damage dealt to your target!

lines.zh: 击杀敌人时，有概率将周围 %1$s 格范围内的所有敌人冻结在原地，持续 %2$s 秒!

lines.zh: 购买一枚可随时引爆的微型核弹，对周围 %2$s 格范围内所有敌人造成其最大生命值 %1$s%的真实伤害。
